Name: test_view_cart_with_added_products[chromium]
Description:
Test: View cart with added products
    Jira Story: QA-4 - View Cart Contents
    Type: Positive
    
    Preconditions: User is on the website and cart contains at least one product
    
    Steps:
    1. Add a product to cart
    2. Click on the cart icon
    3. Verify cart page opens and displays list of all added products 
       with correct names, prices, quantities, and images

Name: test_cart_badge_shows_zero_when_no_items_in_cart[chromium]
Description:
Test: Cart badge shows zero when no items in cart
    Type: Edge Case
    Preconditions: User is logged in and viewing product listings page with empty cart
    
    Verifies that the cart badge shows 0 or is not visible when the cart is empty.

Name: test_rapid_multiple_clicks_on_add_to_cart_button[chromium]
Description:
Test: Rapid multiple clicks on Add to Cart button
    Type: Edge Case
    Preconditions: User is on product page with empty cart
    
    Verifies that rapidly clicking Add to Cart button multiple times
    only adds the product once to the cart.

Name: test_view_cart_with_multiple_products[chromium]
Description:
Test: View cart with multiple added products
    Jira Story: QA-4 - View Cart Contents
    Type: Positive
    
    Preconditions: User is on the website and cart contains multiple products
    
    Steps:
    1. Add multiple products to cart
    2. Click on the cart icon
    3. Verify cart page displays all added products with correct details

Name: test_multiple_logout_attempts[chromium]
Description:
